title: Webb County Sheriff's Office wishes everyone a safe holiday ahead of Veterans Day
excerpt: Sheriff Martin Cuellar and the Webb County Sheriff's Office wished Webb County residents a safe holiday ahead of Veterans Day on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
content:
Sheriff Martin Cuellar and the Webb County Sheriff's Office wished Webb County residents a safe holiday ahead of Veterans Day on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.

The Sheriff's Office shared the message on Facebook on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

Veterans Day honors the men and women who have served in the United States Armed Forces.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, November 10, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
